days.label: Push Day ? Chest, Shoulders & Triceps
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + arm circles + band pull-aparts

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: Still at 135 ? three weeks in a row with zero logs. That's three weeks of nothing to work with. Show up Monday and actually do this. Touch the chest, full 1-second pause, drive through the heels, stay braced the entire set. Need 9-10 reps across all three sets at RPE 7 or lower to earn 140. Log every rep and every RPE ? no log means no progression, full stop.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.notes: Still at 45 ? no logs again this week, third straight week with nothing. Last real data was 10/9/8 at RPE 8/8/8 and sets 2 and 3 were falling apart. 30-degree incline, elbows at 45, 2-second negative on every rep. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 to earn 50. The drop-off in later sets is the pattern to break ? get all three sets clean.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.notes: Still at 35 ? no logs this week. Last session had 8/8/8 at RPE 9/9/9, which means you were grinding, not owning it. Press straight up, full lockout, no lean back, breathe at the top. RPE 9 means your technique is probably breaking down ? check your setup before the first rep. Need all three sets to come down to RPE 7-8 before we touch the weight.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Front Raise
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping out Dumbbell Lateral Raise this week for variety. Lateral raises have been in the slot for several weeks. Alternating or simultaneous, raise to shoulder height, slight elbow bend, controlled negative. Don't use momentum ? if you need to rock to get the weight up it's too heavy. Pick a weight where 10-12 reps is RPE 7. Log the weight ? this is a baseline session.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
exercises.notes: Still at 95 ? no logs this week, bump to 100 stays on hold. Last known data was 10/10/10 at RPE 7/7/7 which absolutely earned the increase, but we need a logged session to confirm it before we move. Hands shoulder-width, elbows tucked tight, lower to the chest, full lockout every rep. Get the log in and 100 lbs is yours next Monday.

exercises.name: Tricep Rope Pushdown
exercises.notes: Second week in rotation ? no logs came in last week so we're still treating this as the baseline session. Rope attachment on the cable, elbows pinned to your sides, push down and split the rope at the bottom for full extension, controlled return all the way up. Pick a weight where 10-12 reps is RPE 7. Log the weight ? can't progress what we can't track.

days.cooldown: Stretch chest, shoulders, and triceps ? 5 min

days.label: Pull Day ? Back, Biceps & Rear Delts
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + band pull-aparts + cat-cow stretches

exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
exercises.notes: Still at 195 ? three weeks without a single log. Last real data was 8/8/8 at RPE 8/8/9 and set 3 was already pushing the limit. Lats tight before you break the floor, bar dragging up the shins, full breath and brace before every single rep. Take the full 2 minutes ? don't shortchange recovery and then wonder why the third set fell apart. Need 8+ reps on all three sets at RPE 7 or lower to earn 205. Log it.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: Still at 110 ? no logs this week. Last session was 10/9/8 at RPE 7/8/8 ? set 1 solid, sets 2 and 3 losing reps and gaining effort. Wide grip, pull to upper chest, hard lat squeeze at the bottom, stay upright ? do not row it down. The set-to-set drop-off is the thing to fix. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 to earn 120.

exercises.name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
exercises.notes: Second week in rotation ? no logs came in last week so this is still the baseline session. Hinge at the hips, flat back, pull the bar to your lower chest or upper abdomen, squeeze the lats hard at the top, controlled descent ? don't let gravity take it. Pick a weight where 8-10 reps is RPE 7. Log the weight.

exercises.name: Cable Face Pull
exercises.notes: Still at 70 ? no logs this week. Last session was 12/12/12 at RPE 7/8/8 ? set 1 clean but sets 2 and 3 climbed. Rope at upper pulley, pull to your face, thumbs pointing behind you at the finish, elbows high, full external rotation. Need 15/15/15 at RPE 7 to earn 75. Push the rep count on every set ? you've got the strength, just need the consistency across sets.

exercises.name: EZ Bar Curl
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping out Hammer Curl this week for variety. Hammer curls have been in the slot for multiple weeks. EZ bar is easier on the wrists than a straight bar ? strict form, elbows pinned to your sides, no swinging, full curl to the top, 2-second negative. Pick a weight where 8-10 reps is RPE 7. Log the weight ? this is a baseline session.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.notes: Third week treating this as the baseline session ? still no logs. Alternating or simultaneous, elbows pinned to your sides, supinate at the top, controlled negative. Pick a weight where 8-10 reps is RPE 7 and log it. This can't keep rolling forward as 'baseline' forever ? pick your weight and commit to it.

days.cooldown: Stretch lats, biceps, and upper back ? 5 min

days.label: Leg Day ? Quads, Hamstrings, Glutes & Core
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + bodyweight squats + leg swings

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.notes: Still at 165 ? three weeks without a log. Last real data was 8/8/8 at RPE 8/8/8 ? stuck at 8 reps and stuck at RPE 8. Below parallel, big breath before you unrack, brace hard, drive through the heels, chest up out of the hole. Take the full 2 minutes ? no shortcuts. Need 9-10 reps on all three sets at RPE 7 or under to earn 175. The rep count is the thing to attack Friday. Show up.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Still at 155 ? no logs this week. Last session was 10/9/10 at RPE 7/8/8 ? set 1 great, sets 2 and 3 lost a rep and effort climbed. Slight knee bend, hips back, bar close to the legs, feel the hamstring stretch at the bottom, do not let the lower back round. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 to earn 165. Sets 2 and 3 are where you're losing it ? focus rest between those sets.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Walking Lunges
exercises.notes: Second week in rotation ? no logs came in last week so this is still the baseline session. Long stride for glutes, short stride for quads ? pick one and be consistent throughout all three sets. Dumbbells at your sides, controlled descent, drive through the front heel to stand. Pick a weight where 10-12 reps per leg is RPE 7. Log the weight.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.notes: Still at 85 ? no logs this week. Last session was 12/10/10 at RPE 8/8/8 ? set 1 hit 12 but sets 2 and 3 fell to 10 with high effort throughout. Upper back on the bench, drive through the heels, full hip extension, hard squeeze at the top for a full second, controlled descent. Need 12/12/12 at RPE 7 to earn 90. Don't let sets 2 and 3 fall apart ? rest the full 75 seconds.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping out Leg Curl this week for variety. Leg curls have been in the slot for multiple weeks. Leg extension on the leg attachment, squeeze the quads hard at the top of each rep, 2-second hold, controlled negative ? don't let the weight slam back down. Pick a weight where 12-15 reps is RPE 7. Log the weight ? this is a baseline session.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.notes: Third week treating this as the baseline session ? still no logs. Kneel facing the pulley, rope behind your head, crunch down with your abs ? not your hips. Don't just pull the weight down with your arms. Pick a weight where 10-12 reps is RPE 7 and log it. Same situation as dumbbell curl ? this can't stay 'baseline' indefinitely. Pick a weight this week.

days.cooldown: Stretch quads, hamstrings, hip flexors ? 5 min
